brief:
Al-Khair Foundation has strongly rejected allegations of connections to Hamas, Middle East Eye reported. The British charity faces investigation following accusations made by UK Lawyers for Israel and insists it maintains no ties with the Palestinian group.

The foundation's denial comes as it undergoes scrutiny over the claimed links. The investigation was initiated after the organization was placed under formal review, though the charity contests the basis for the allegations against it. Specific operational details and evidence cited in the investigation remain largely undisclosed at present.
